PageMetadata.description: Where this page sits in the whole result.

totalPages.description: Number of pages at this size.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem detail returned for every error that has a body.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code; branch on this, not on `detail`.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation, safe to show to the user.

status.description: HTTP status, repeated in the body.

bearerAuth.description: Token from POST /api/auth/login, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens last 8 hours; there is no refresh, log in again.

info.description: Backend API for Ausan Poultry Farm: stock, deliveries, finance and reports. Money is PHP with 2 decimals; dates are Manila business dates. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code` (see the Problem schema).
info.title: Ausan Farm System API
